title: Unlocking Circadian Rhythms in Lynch Syndrome-associated cancer
summary: Exploring genetic factors in colorectal and endometrial cancer development.
description: The circadian clock orchestrates the rhythmic physiology of organisms influencing the expression of up to 40% of protein-coding genes. This project investigates how circadian disruption may contribute to cancer development in patients with Lynch Syndrome focusing on colorectal and endometrial cancer.

title: Identifying the link between the circadian clock and cardiac arrhythmia
summary: Investigating circadian contributions to cardiac arrhythmia susceptibility.
description: The circadian clock is known to affect multiple aspects of health. This project uses the Genomics England 100000 Genomes dataset to explore the relationship between circadian clock gene variants and cardiac arrhythmia phenotypes.

title: Is genetic chronotype linked to susceptibility to acute Covid-19 infection?
summary: Exploring circadian immune responses and Covid-19 susceptibility.
description: The circadian clock plays a critical role in human immune system homeostasis with immune responses mediated time dependently. This project investigates whether genetic chronotype influences susceptibility to acute Covid-19 infection.

title: Are mutations in UBR4 associated with Long QT syndrome?
summary: Investigating UBR4 in cardiac arrhythmias using the 100K dataset.
description: UBR4 is a single copy gene that is highly conserved across kingdoms. Recent work has shown roles in circadian regulation and this project asks whether mutations in UBR4 are associated with Long QT syndrome or other cardiac arrhythmias.

title: Investigating pathogenic non-coding variants in CYP21A2
summary: Studying circadian steroidogenesis in congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
description: This project examines how pathogenic non-coding variants in CYP21A2 impact circadian steroid production patterns in patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia.

title: Enrichment analysis of circadian genes in rheumatoid arthritis
summary: Analysing disease-associated and circadian gene overlap in RA.
description: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic systemic inflammatory autoimmune disease. This project performs enrichment analysis to identify overlap between RA-associated genes and circadian-regulated genes.

title: Identification of chronopharmacogenomic (Chrono-PGx) variants
summary: Identifying genetic variants that alter drug responses across circadian time.
description: This project aims to identify and evaluate genetic variants that influence how drug responses vary with circadian timing, so that when a medicine is given can be matched to the patient.

title: Enhancing Diagnostic Equity Using Disease Super Panels
summary: Improving equity and coverage of genetic diagnostic testing.
description: This project develops novel panel approaches to enhance diagnostic equity in genetic testing ensuring broader population coverage.
